title: Minimum Time to Kill All Monsters
summary: Given an array of monster powers, determine the minimum number of days required to defeat all monsters starting with zero mana, gaining one mana point per day, and resetting mana to zero after defeating a monster, with the gain increasing by one after each defeat.
statement: Given an array of monster powers, determine the minimum number of days required to defeat all monsters starting with zero mana, gaining one mana point per day, and resetting mana to zero after defeating a monster, with the gain increasing by one after each defeat.
constraints: power contains 1 through 17 positive monster strengths.
Gain starts at one, increases after each defeated monster, and accumulated mana resets to zero after a defeat.
Return the minimum total days needed to defeat every monster.
hints: Only the set of defeated monsters determines the current gain.
Use a bitmask state and try every remaining monster as the next defeat.
For each mask, add ceil(power/gain) days for one remaining monster and memoize the cheapest continuation.
The recurrence considers every possible defeat order while merging orders with the same defeated set; optimal substructure makes the minimum continuation exact.
editorial: The recurrence considers every possible defeat order while merging orders with the same defeated set; optimal substructure makes the minimum continuation exact.

tests.explanation: Defeat strengths one, four, and three at gains one, two, and three for 1+2+1=4 days.
An optimal order needs six total days as the gain rises from one through four.
